# 3D Models Directory

Place your Kawasaki Ninja GLB/GLTF model files here:

- ninja_300.glb
- ninja_400.glb  
- ninja_650.glb
- ninja_zx6r.glb
- ninja_zx10r.glb

## Requirements

- Format: GLB or GLTF
- Size: Optimized for web (< 5MB recommended)
- Position: Models should be centered at origin (0,0,0)
- Scale: Will be adjusted automatically in the viewer

## Finding Models

You can find free motorcycle 3D models at:
- Sketchfab.com (search for "motorcycle" or "ninja bike")
- Free3D.com
- CGTrader.com (has free models)
- TurboSquid.com

Make sure to respect the licensing terms of any models you use.
